limitations.note: The agent corrected the pattern but compared the next shift-register value instead of the pre-edge value, moving the match pulse one clock earlier than the original design.

The test compared `match` against the already-shifted expected value, so its passing result confirmed the agent’s timing assumption rather than checking that the original registered timing was preserved.
